name: Isabel Wiseler-Lima - § 55 - Am 20
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 2. Insists that respect, protection and fulfilment of human rights and fundamental freedoms must be the cornerstone of the EU’s external policy; strongly encourages the EU, to that end, to strive for a continued ambitious commitment to make human rights a central part of all EU policies, including trade agreements, in a streamlined manner, and to enhance the consistency between the EU’s internal and external policies in this field;
